decisions: Simulation uses food/house-based reproduction requiring two fed parents per house instead of simple probability reproduction
Each gene has independent random mutation chance (dashboard adjustable) instead of fixed 5%
Genes inherited randomly per-gene from either parent
Population cap raised to 10000, genes per person up to 10
open_questions: Whether log/graph performance is acceptable at 10,000 population scale

decisions: Grouped 50 genes into scrollable checkbox list by mechanic (7-8 per mechanic)
Kept simulation log capped at 200 lines for performance
Population cap raised to 1,000,000 despite performance cost since it's plain JS math per person

Give every gene its own unique numeric strength value instead of grouping identical genes by category, so genes sharing a mechanic differ in magnitude (e.g. Thick Skin -10% disease vs Antibody Boost -9%)
